title: Chapter 467
text:
Helping Ames catch Aesop had completed the mission, and Han Xiao was originally happy. However, when he turned around, he saw a group of Godora warriors hurriedly passing by, and his mood instantly dropped.

He recognized Godora's combat uniform. These people were not low-level investigators but special forces that specialized in combat. The leader was a very famous high-level Godora Super in his previous life. In Version 2.0, this person was the main person who dealt with the Mutation Disaster in Blue Star. Most of the combat missions that the players received from Godora were issued by him, and he was equivalent to a commander. He was a very important NPC to the players, so Han Xiao was very familiar with him.

Nagojin, a high-level officer in Godora's War Bureau, a Grade A Pugilist. Only important missions would send him out. For him to appear in Noriose definitely meant that something important had happened. Han Xiao immediately thought of the mixed-blood Godora, Ovenn, that he had met a few days ago.

The two should be related … Han Xiaoxin thought.

There was another strange thing that puzzled him. The Nagojin in front of him was extraordinarily handsome and had a masculine temperament. However, in Han Xiao's memory, when the Blue Star players first met him, Nagojin was in a crippled state. Half of his face was almost a skeleton. Not only was his face disfigured, his left arm and legs had become mechanical prosthetics, and many artificial organs had been implanted in his body to maintain his life.

Now, less than a year had passed since the start of Version 2.0.

Therefore, Nagojin had been crippled in this year, but he did not know the exact time.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he immediately took action. He shook off the upper echelons of Noriose and stood in front of Nagojin.

"Who are you? Don't block the way. "The group of Godora warriors stopped, and Nagojin frowned as he sized up Han Xiao.

Han Xiao gave a simple introduction.

"Black Star? Oh, I've heard of your name. You and some other mercenaries captured a Dark-star mothership. Well done. "

Nagojin nodded and did not pay much attention to it. People of his rank usually paid attention to more important matters. He only knew about Han Xiao's name because one of his subordinates mentioned it by chance. He was in a hurry, so he patiently asked, "Why are you stopping us?"

"It's just a greeting. By the way, do you need any help?" Han Xiao asked. This was a common opening line used by players. He was trying to see if he could trigger a mission to find out the goals of these Godora players. He lacked information and did not know about the confrontation between Dark-star and Godora in Noriose. He only felt that something was amiss.

This group of warriors was the reinforcements sent by Godora, and their mission was to rescue Ovenn. In the past few days, two more of Ovenn's doppelgangers had been captured, and the situation could not be delayed. Ovenn knew from the senses of his doppelgangers that the strongest person in the Dark-star team was a Grade B Super called Fausthod. Thus, Godora sent out Nagojin, who was the closest to them, thinking that it would be enough to deal with the enemy.

Nagojin felt that he did not need help and could deal with the enemy this time. Thus, he perfunctorily said, "We don't need your help. We're in a hurry, so we'll be leaving first."

Then, Nagojin walked past Han Xiao and left with his men.

Looking at the backs of these people, Han Xiao stroked his chin. "Tsk, I didn't trigger a mission. An incident that requires a Calamity Grade Super to take action is probably quite risky."

Since Nagojin did not welcome outsiders, then so be it. He could not be bothered to be snubbed.

He opened the interface. Ames' Character Summon Card that he had obtained previously, but he had not checked it yet.

Character Summon Card — Ames: [Force Field — Dragon's Gaze] Compresses a medium within a certain range (Can be solid, liquid, or gas) and applies it to a target, causing the target to enter the [Immobilization] state. For every 100 STR the target has, the duration will be reduced by 1s. Basic duration is 18s. Usage: 0/1

Han Xiao felt that it was alright to obtain a powerful control skill. Ames had many skills, and at her level, at least seventy percent of them were useful. Although they were not powerful attacks, control skills were more flexible, and each had its own pros and cons.

The group left the spaceport and returned to the surface. They rented a temporary stronghold, and he planned to rest there for a few days. At the same time, he bought some supplies. Noriose had many shops, and he planned to strengthen his combat machines. Two High-End Knowledges and many Advanced Knowledges could be combined into better blueprints, which was enough for him to upgrade once. He still had more than two hundred million EXP on his interface, and as long as he was frugal, he would have enough to combine blueprints.

Just as everyone was resting, a storm quietly broke out.

…

At the edge of Noriose City 4 …

Nagojin brought dozens of Godora warriors to a skyscraper in an aircraft. There were many tall buildings nearby, and not far away was the maglev station that connected to the city.

According to Ovenn's intelligence, the stronghold of the Dark-star forces was located on the eightieth floor of this building, right in the middle of the building.

Ovenn's main body had been in contact with the rescue team. He used his doppelganger to observe the Dark-star members and provide clues to Nagojin. His request was to deal with the Dark-star forces. Only after confirming that there was no danger would his main body appear. He was very cautious.

"The majority of the enemy's forces are inside. We will destroy the enemy's base first before dealing with the DarkStar members outside. Otherwise, we will alert the enemy. Now that the enemy's base does not know that we are here, we have the advantage of intelligence. Follow me!"

The aircraft slowly rose and approached the target floor. Nagojin's expression was serious. He slowly clenched his fist, and a thick golden flame flowed along his arm like liquid.

He punched the outer wall.

Boom!

In the blink of an eye, a visible white circular shockwave spread out hundreds of meters in all directions!

All the glass in the building shattered!

The force of the punch penetrated through the eightieth floor, leaving behind a hole that penetrated from the front to the back. The structure of the building creaked, and the middle of the building caved in, like a wooden stick that was almost snapped in half!

Not to mention buildings, even a Calamity Grade Pugilist could destroy a battleship with their bare hands. As long as they had enough time, they could even transform into a self-propelled bulldozer and flatten the surface of an entire planet.

After destroying the terrain with a single punch, Nagojin led his subordinates and charged in. He immediately saw the dizzy Fausthod and the others.

Nagojin made a hand gesture, and dozens of Godora soldiers surrounded Fausthod's team. "I am Nagojin from Godora's War Bureau. You have been surrounded. Put down your weapons and surrender. I will send you to Rainbow Prison."

The building shook, and Fausthod stabilized himself. He revealed a savage smile as though he had seen his prey fall into a trap. "Looks like we have caught a big fish. Nagojin, look to your left and right. Who do you think is the one being surrounded?"

Two surging energy waves suddenly erupted, and Nagojin's troops were sandwiched in the middle.

Nagojin hurriedly turned around and saw Anur and Ashes staring at him from both sides.

The thick killing intent almost froze the air.

"Why are there two Calamity Grade Supers? The information is wrong! "Nagojin's expression changed drastically.

Ovenn's information indicated that the strongest person in the hunting team was only a Grade B. Godora had sent out a Grade A as insurance. With Nagojin taking action, even if Dark-star had a Grade A, both sides would still be evenly matched. However, they did not expect Dark-star to send out two Calamity Grade Supers to hunt down the traitor. This was like using a sledgehammer to kill a chicken. This was a trap set by Dark-star.

Anur and Ashes did not appear in front of Ovenn's doppelganger. Fausthod pretended to be the captain and misled Ovenn that there were no Calamity Grade Supers in their team. Dark-star had guessed that Godora would send reinforcements, so they deliberately misled Ovenn and guessed that there would only be one Grade A Super in the reinforcements. This person was Anur and Ashes' prey!

Dark-star not only wanted to hunt down Ovenn but also set up an ambush to make Godora lose a top combatant!

This was the reason why Anur and Ashes acted together. Godora had fallen into Dark-star's trap.

The Godora warriors present felt a chill run down their spines. The pressure from two strong enemies almost made their hearts stop beating. They were extremely nervous and did not know which direction to defend.

Nagojin's expression was grave. He knew that he was in danger and took a deep breath.

"We will die today …"

Hu!

Pugilist flames covered his entire body, and his energy fluctuations were on par with Anur and Ember's. He assumed a battle stance, and his gaze became resolute. His cheeks were clenched, and he squeezed out a roar from between his gritted teeth.
